welcome.title: Welcome to Smart Second Brain
welcome.subtitle: Turn your vault into an AI-assisted second brain — search smarter, explore connections in a graph, and chat with your notes.
welcome.hotkeys_unavailable_notice: Couldn't open Hotkeys — open Settings → Hotkeys and search for “Search notes”.

search.title: Smarter search
search.desc: Find notes by title, content, tags, and folders — with fuzzy matching. No setup needed. Add an embedding model later for semantic search.
search.navbar_toggle: Open from the navbar magnifier instead of the quick switcher

graph.title: Smarter graph
graph.desc: See how your notes connect and cluster into topics. No setup needed.

chat.title: Chat with your notes
chat.desc: Ask questions grounded in your vault, with web search and plugins like Dataview and Tasks integrated in. Needs an AI provider — set one up below.

provider_step.title: Connect an AI provider
provider_step.done_desc: Provider connected. You can add or manage providers in settings.
provider_step.desc: Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

model_step.title: Choose a chat model
model_step.needs_provider_desc: Connect a provider first, then pick a model to chat with.
model_step.desc: Pick a model from your connected provider to enable chat.
model_step.using: Using {model}. You're all set to start chatting.

privacy.public_title: Your notes are shared by default
privacy.no_provider_title: Note access is private by default
privacy.no_provider: Your notes are {not} shared with AI providers unless you allow it. Once you connect a provider above, you can grant it access — nothing leaves your vault before then.
privacy.public: Note access is set to {mode}, so providers can read your notes except the ones you exclude. {review}.

all_trusted.one: Your provider is marked {trusted}, so the agent can read your notes. {review} to keep specific notes private.
all_trusted.other: Your providers are marked {trusted}, so the agent can read your notes. {review} to keep specific notes private.

untrusted.one: {providers} can't read your notes yet — chat will work, but answers won't be grounded in your vault. Mark it as {trusted} in provider settings, or {change} to allow all providers.
untrusted.other: {providers} can't read your notes yet — chat will work, but answers won't be grounded in your vault. Mark them as {trusted} in provider settings, or {change} to allow all providers.

welcome.start_chatting_disabled: Connect a provider and add a chat model first

provider_setup.directory_desc: {count} more services that speak the OpenAI API, from the models.dev directory. Smart Second Brain hasn't tested them; each becomes a Custom provider you can edit.
provider_setup.directory_empty: No provider matches. A service that isn't listed can still be added as a Custom provider.
provider_setup.name_desc: Name this provider instance so you can distinguish it later.
provider_setup.sign_in_desktop_only: {provider} sign-in is only available on desktop.
provider_setup.fix_name_to_finish: — fix the provider name to finish
provider_setup.enter_credentials: Enter your credentials above — the connection is checked automatically.
provider_setup.trusted_desc: Allow this provider to access notes that remain private for untrusted providers.
provider_setup.paste_code_desc: Copy the authorization code shown in the browser and paste it here to finish connecting.
